items.title: Democratizing weather derivatives through tokenization could be crypto's most important real-world use case
items.summary: Main Street, which faces the most significant climate-related financial risk, currently lacks an avenue to hedge weather-related risks, argues CoinDesk’s Omkar Godbole.

items.title: Wise to resubmit US charter application under GENIUS Act
items.summary: The OCC denied the UK company’s application this week citing AML/CFT risks, despite approving similar charters for digital asset companies in the last year.

items.title: A quantum roadmap would push Bitcoin much higher: Charles Edwards
items.summary: A Bitcoin development roadmap that addresses quantum computing risks could see the price surge by “double digits” very quickly, according to Charles Edwards.

items.title: Thailand SEC files complaint against Bitkub over alleged false disclosures
items.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitkub and two former directors over alleged false disclosures linked to a 2021 cyberattack involving $50 million in assets.

items.title: Shiba Inu surges 36% as South Korean traders fuel mystery rally
items.summary: The rally has no announcement behind it, other dog tokens haven't matched it, and Korean venues are carrying the volume.

items.title: Crypto exchange BitMart to shut down after nine years, BMX token crashes 58%
items.summary: Users have a month to close trades and six months to withdraw, and the exchange gave no specific reason for closing.

items.title: BitMart to wind down exchange, end trading by Aug. 26
items.summary: Crypto exchange BitMart said it will wind down operations after its BMX token plunged and users reported withdrawal delays, with platform operations set to end in January.

items.title: Binance ‘red teams’ its own staff every month to keep hackers out
items.summary: Binance regularly tests its employees for security hygiene, with social engineering becoming a major source of industry breaches.

items.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
items.summary: New regulations for crypto trading, custody, and settlement in Russia take effect Sept. 1, with requirements for licensed intermediaries applying from July 2027.

items.title: North Korea arrests hackers accused of laundering stolen funds from country's bank via crypto
items.summary: The group allegedly breached Central Bank systems, converted crypto to cash via Chinese brokers, and used small transfers to evade detection.

items.title: Robinhood Chain's real-world assets jump fivefold as tokenized stocks start trading in bigger size
items.summary: The chain built to put equities onchain has tripled in size since mid-July, and a dozen tokenized stocks are now each clearing $500,000 a day. Real-world assets are growing fast, though memecoins and stablecoins still dominate the chain.

items.title: Robinhood in talks with Crypto.com over prediction markets: WSJ
items.summary: While prediction market companies in the US continue to face legal battles between state and federal authorities, Robinhood is reportedly considering expanding its services.

items.title: Bitcoin advocacy group to join US State Department’s ‘digital freedom’ program
items.summary: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and three partner organizations will be able to send employees to work alongside State Department officials to address issues including digital freedom.

items.title: North Korea arrests bank hacking ring tied to crypto laundering: Report
items.summary: Daily NK reported that North Korea arrested former state cyber operators accused of hacking two state banks and laundering funds through crypto.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Fidelity joins push for Senate passage of CLARITY Act
items.summary: Fidelity called on the US Senate to pass the CLARITY Act, joining industry groups and crypto firms pushing for market structure legislation.

items.title: Dango’s perp DEX taps out nearly 4 months after launch
items.summary: Dango will close its network on Aug. 13, joining BitMEX, Odos and Satori Finance in a wave of recent crypto shutdowns.
